svg.text: How many results are on chain? Two questions, so two numbers.
Live rig, read at 2026-10-18T11:56:40.823Z. Recomputed from /api/ledger and the published bundles,
then compared against the two counters /api/state publishes; the figure refuses to draw if they disagree.
chain commitments -- a transaction exists that anybody can look up
sealed as published -- the bytes on the site NOW are the bytes that commitment covers
The amber block is not missing work. Those 7 records were sealed on chain, then measured again
by the rotating survey: a bundle hash folds the run's timestamp, so the new bundle is a hash the chain
never saw, and its stale stamp is dropped rather than inherited. The transaction stays; the count falls.
Before this pass, one field fed a tile labelled "on-chain". It carried the smaller number.
Both are published now, each with the question it answers, because a single total would be wrong
in both directions: the small one understates what was committed, the big one overstates
what a reader can verify against the record in front of them.
Excluded from the total: 0 anchored row(s) with no signature, 0 stamped
bundle(s) with no ledger row. A failed retry can no longer demote a landed row (mergeLedgerRow).
Source: https://spacedatarig.app/api/state and https://spacedatarig.app/api/ledger | generator: scripts/anchor-counts-figure.ts | nothing gated, claimed or spent.
